ROM $value$plusargs/$readmemh initial blocks -> fixed $readmemh of the committed-hash ROM payload

yosys_frontend_whole_voice.command: yosys -s <read_verilog synthesis view; hierarchy -check -top one_shot_voice_top; proc; opt_clean; check; write_json; flatten; opt_clean; check>
yosys_frontend_whole_voice.note: pre-mapping inventory. Yosys' default synth maps $mul via alumacc/maccmap adder trees; no multiplier was mapped to gf180 cells in this record except inside quarter_wave_lut (see targets). Division is not an operator here: restoring long division is unrolled shift/subtract logic.

constraints.clock_basis: DR-0010 bound clock (SCHED_BOUND_CLOCK_MHZ=25); candidate clocks 25/50/100 MHz, none selected
constraints.generated_clocks_and_enables: ctl_*/audio phase enables are ordinary synchronous inputs sequenced by the host; no generated clock, clock gate or multicycle exception exists or is declared, so every path is timed single-cycle at the one clock. klt sta cannot express multicycle/false-path exceptions (friction F5).
constraints.memory_treatment: no memory macro / SRAM is instantiated or assumed: the quarter-wave ROMs are plain 'reg [..] rom [0:4096]' arrays initialised by $readmemh in the synthesis view and left to Yosys memory inference (memory_map to flip-flops/mux logic or constant folding); klt's memory_mapping evidence records what actually happened.
constraints.reset_assumption: rst is an asynchronous active-high input (posedge rst in every engine); it is constrained like any other non-clock input (input delay 8.0 ns), so recovery/removal against clk are timed; no reset synchronizer exists in this RTL and none is assumed.
constraints.wire_load: none: klt sta verilog mode, liberty default, no placement/parasitics

five_rom_copies_as_logic.note: 2 quarter_wave_lut in square_saw_vco_engine + 1 inline in sine_vco_engine + 2 in lfo_vca_engine; the 24-bit and 25-bit ROM variants differ slightly, so this is approximate
